result.text:
The US is cutting off indian outsourcing IT companies,

By suspending PERM labor certifications will not only end the H-1B immigration scam in the IT industry.

It will take away the biggest advantage Indian IT company has:

Wage arbitrage: billing US clients at high rates while paying salaries based on Indian standards. This critical enabler allows indian companies to rotate Indian engineers to the US on H-1B visas for onsite client work, which often led to green card sponsorship via PERM.

The suspension of PERM, combined with existing H-1B restrictions, fundamentally disrupts this playbook.

Now, Indian companies with onsite projects in the US have to hire American workers and pay them a living wage. https://t.co/3drCbHvHtI
